# Sample queries for polyql translate --file.
# Blank lines and lines beginning with # are skipped, so a file can carry notes.

# Translates exactly into LogQL: rate over a window exists in both languages.
rate(http_requests_total[5m])

# Also exact: a group aggregation over a range aggregation.
sum by (job) (rate(http_requests_total{status="500"}[5m]))

# Approximate: PromQL's bool modifier returns 0/1, which LogQL cannot write.
up > bool 5

# Incomplete: LogQL has no histogram_quantile.
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])))

# Incomplete: LogQL has no join, so the vector matching cannot be expressed.
sum(rate(a[5m])) / on (job) group_left (env) sum(rate(b[5m]))

# Incomplete: LogQL has no subquery form.
rate(http_requests_total[5m])[30m:1m]
